purpose: Define model output as inert generated evidence/content linked to exact inference request/model/backend/context and never as canonical operation authority.

topics.name: Model Output Evidence
topics.purpose: Define model output as inert generated evidence/content linked to exact inference request/model/backend/context and never as canonical operation authority.

semantics.identity_rule: Each machine-significant output has an explicit output/result identity.
semantics.confidence_rule: Model self-confidence is descriptive and not verification evidence.
semantics.canonical_rule: Generated content does not become canonical data/config/code merely by generation.
semantics.authority_rule: Output cannot execute operations or grant rights.

invariants.rule: Command, Routine, Trigger, Schedule, Tool and model definitions remain separate from invocations, requests, executions and results; definitions never create effects merely by existing.
Automated work still resolves exact operation/target/context and must cross validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before any effect occurs.

references.purpose: Output must cross explicit effect boundary.
